verdict.rationale: Docs show flows can be handed to agents as reusable 'tools' that other automations call ('build that part as a flow and hand it over', 'You attach individual actions, not whole apps'), implying some sub-workflow/module reuse, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'call flow from flow' or nested sub-workflow feature in the visual builder itself. missing for 10: explicit sub-workflow/child-flow invocation mechanism in the flow builder, versioning/interface contracts for reusable modules, independent confirmation of this pattern in practice.
